scenes.say: Ever wonder why the order of middleware in ASP.NET Core is such a big deal? Let's see how it can make or break your app.

scenes.label: Pipeline
scenes.sub: Requests flow through middleware, each can change or handle them.
scenes.say: ASP.NET Core handles every request through a pipeline. Each middleware can inspect, change, or even end the request right there.
Order matters. For example, authentication must run before authorization, or users won't be recognized. Custom logic goes after security checks.
In your startup file, you add authentication, then authorization, then your endpoints. Get this order wrong, and your app might let anyone in—or lock everyone out.

scenes.question: Where should auth middleware go?
scenes.right: Authentication must run before authorization, or access checks will fail.
scenes.say: Here's a classic interview trap: put authentication after authorization, and your access checks will always fail. Always run authentication first.
